title_zh: 确定地质社团只观察并记录采石场样本

scenario.label_zh: 确定地质社团只观察并记录采石场样本
scenario.goal_zh: 选择可安全观察的岩层和疑似化石，约定拍照标注而不取走或过早确认样本

context_zh: 地质社团成员在有公共步道的旧采石场讨论记录方法。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: Is that curved mark in the rock a fossil?

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: It might be, but we should not identify it from this distance. Take a photograph with the location noted.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: There is a small fragment on the path too. Should I bring it to the meeting?

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: Leave it here. Our exploration of the quarry does not include collecting samples.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: Then I will photograph the larger rock formation from the viewing point.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: Good. We can compare its layers with the guidebook and ask our leader about the curved mark.

sentences.speaker: Erin
sentences.text: I will label the picture as unidentified rather than write a species name.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: That will give us a useful question for the meeting without claiming more than we know.

targets.sense_zh: 自然形成的岩层或岩体
